_comment: Class names used in a v2 surface that no stylesheet defines, and which are
CORRECT anyway. A class with no rule is not automatically a defect: it can be
a semantic hook on an element styled entirely inline, or a modifier whose
sibling is styled and which is deliberately neutral. What is a defect is an
element that was meant to be styled and is not, and no scanner can tell those
apart — so each entry here names why it is fine.
An entry without a reason is the thing this file exists to prevent.

allow.reason: A naming hook only. The element carries its entire layout in an inline style attribute (grid, columns, gap, padding, font-size), so there is nothing for a rule to add. Retire this entry by moving that inline style into a real .es-manifest-row rule.

A deliberately neutral modifier. `.tb-dep-row.dn svg` is coloured with --warning because 'blocks' is the alarming direction; 'depends on' carries `up` and is intentionally left at the default colour. The class marks the direction for readers and for any future rule.
